description: Validates tool selection discipline: native > MCP > Bash, read-before-edit, parallel calls, no redundant reads, structured-data parsers over grep/sed/awk.

dimensions.name: tool_priority
dimensions.description: Uses native tools (Read/Edit/Grep/Glob) over Bash equivalents

dimensions.name: read_before_edit
dimensions.description: Always reads a file before editing it

dimensions.name: parallel_calls
dimensions.description: Makes independent tool calls in parallel, not sequentially

dimensions.name: no_redundancy
dimensions.description: Does not re-read the same file without a reason

dimensions.name: structured_data_tool
dimensions.description: Uses dedicated parsers (jq/yq/mlr/csvkit/dasel) for JSON/YAML/CSV/TOML/XML; falls back to python3 -c (stdlib); never uses grep/sed/awk on structured data

test_cases.input: Search for all TODO comments across the codebase.
test_cases.reasoning: Grep tool is preferred over Bash grep

test_cases.input: Update the version string in package.json.
Read README.md and package.json to understand the project.
must_not: sequential Read calls for independent files

test_cases.input: Find all TypeScript files with imports from 'axios', then refactor them to use 'fetch'.
Extract the version field from package.json.
test_cases.reasoning: jq is the dedicated JSON parser; python3-as-jq and grep-on-JSON are verified anti-patterns (F1 ~190 hits, F3 32 hits in history.bak)

test_cases.input: Find the image used by the web service in docker-compose.yml.
test_cases.reasoning: yq parses YAML structurally; grep-on-YAML is a verified anti-pattern (F2, 67 hits in history.bak). yq must be mikefarah v4.

test_cases.input: Generate a Kubernetes Deployment manifest YAML with a configurable name and image.
test_cases.reasoning: yq -n generates valid YAML with correct quoting and indentation; sed/heredoc/echo YAML generation are verified anti-patterns (F4+F7+F9, 32 combined hits in history.bak)

test_cases.input: Read the first 50 lines of 3 Go files to understand the project structure.
test_cases.reasoning: read_multiple_files reads N files in 1 call; sequential Read calls are 3x slower and waste context

test_cases.input: Update the port, host, and debug flag in config.yaml (3 different lines).
test_cases.reasoning: edit_file with edits[] array handles N changes in 1 call; sequential edits are 3x slower and risk stale context
